name: Royal Niger Company
alt: Royal Niger Company Chartered and Limited

successors.name: Niger Coast Protectorate
successors.text: the Company's territories south of Lokoja (Onitsha and the lower Niger), added to the Southern Nigeria Protectorate on 1 January 1900

successors.name: Northern Nigeria Protectorate
successors.text: the Company's territories at and north of Lokoja, Northern Nigeria Protectorate from 1 January 1900 (capital Lokoja from 1900)

ledger.x: 1886 (July): the Royal Niger Company is chartered.
1900 (1 January): the southern territories go to Southern Nigeria.
1900 (1 January): the northern territories go to the Northern Nigeria Protectorate.
1900 (1 January): the Royal Niger Company's rule ends.

certainty.note: No page gives the Company's territory; the shapes are two circles standing for river stations.
